product.name: Monoprice 8K Ultra High Speed Fiber Optic Certified HDMI Cable - 8K@60Hz 4K@120Hz 48Gbps HDR VRR Active Optical Cable (AOC) CMP Plenum Rated 49ft Black
product.description: Monoprice™ SlimRun™ AV8K Certified Ultra High Speed AOC HDMI® Cable, CMP Plenum RatedNext Generation Technology Delivers 8K@60Hz performance, 48Gbps Bandwidth, Dynamic HDR, and eARC Over Incredible DistancesThe Monoprice™ SlimRun™ AV 8K Certified Ultra High Speed AOC HDMI® Cable enables full 8K performance over distances up to 65 feet. These cables are certified by an HDMI-authorized testing center; it supports up to 8K@60Hz or 4K@120Hz resolutions with up to 48Gbps bandwidth and all other features found in the HDMI 2.1 specification. The cables feature next-gen fiber optic technology, making it the perfect choice for the latest gaming consoles, including the Sony® PlayStation® 5, PlayStation 5 Digital Edition, Nintendo Switch™, Microsoft® Xbox Series X™, and Xbox Series S™. Being CMP Plenum-rated, it is certified for in-wall installation in the plenum air spaces of commercial and residential buildings.Active Optical Cable (AOC) improves signal performance over longer lengthsSupports 8K@60Hz and 4K@120Hz resolutionsDynamic HDR supportCertified by an HDMI-authorized testing centerUp to 48Gbps bandwidthBest option for PlayStation® 5, Nintendo Switch™, Xbox Series X™, Xbox Series S™ and other game consolesThe Plenum (CMP) fire safety rating of this cable means that it is safe for use in the plenum air duct spaces of commercial and residential buildings. CERTIFIED SLIMRUN AV 8KThe Ultra High Speed HDMI Cable supports up to 48Gbps bandwidth to handle all features in the HDMI® 2.1 specification. It features very low EMI emission, is backward-compatible with earlier versions of the HDMI specification, and is functional with all existing HDMI devices. SMOOTHEST AND FASTEST ACTION DETAILSMonoprice™ SlimRun™ AV 8K Certified cables support uncompressed resolutions and refresh rates up to 8K@60Hz and 4K@120Hz for immersive viewing and smooth, fast-action detail. 8K RESOLUTION AT LENGTHS NEVER POSSIBLE BEFORESlimRun™ AV 8K Certified Cables use an active chipset and optical fiber to support uncompressed video at resolutions up to 8K@60Hz and 4K@120Hz, with cable lengths never possible with traditional copper cables before.Available Lengths: 24, 32, 49, and 65 ft ENHANCED FEATURES FOR THE BEST GAMING EXPERIENCEVariable Refresh Rate (VRR) reduces or eliminates lag, stutter, and frame tearing for more fluid and detailed gameplay.Auto Low Latency Mode (ALLM) allows the ideal latency setting to automatically set for a smooth, lag-free, and uninterrupted experience.Quick Frame Transport (QFT) reduces latency for smoother no lag gaming and real-time interactive virtual reality. DYNAMIC HDR SUPPORTMonoprice™ SlimRun™ Cables feature Dynamic HDR support to ensure every moment in a video is displayed at its ideal values for depth, detail, brightness, contrast, and wider color gamuts on a scene-by-scene and frame-by-frame basis. With support for up to 12 bits per channel color depth, this cable increases the color spaces and brightness with dynamic color mapping. ARC, EARC, DOLBY ATMOS, AND DTS:X SUPPORTSlimRun™ AV 8K Certified Cables are fully compatible with the HDMI® ARC/eARC (Audio Return Channel/Enhanced Audio Return Channel) feature, supporting immersive, multichannel audio streams, including the Dolby Atmos® and DTS:X® advanced 5.1/7.1 channel surround sound modes. .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}Lifetime WarrantyWith Monoprice's Lifetime Warranty, you can rest assured we stand behind our products and our customers.
